verdict.rationale: Pipedream is a SaaS workflow and integration platform with AI features such as AI error debugging and AI agents, so a training opt-out is a fair question for it. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions a training opt-out, a no-training commitment, data-usage controls, or a privacy policy on AI training. The Connect environment isolation evidence concerns separating credentials between development and production, not AI training data, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
